title: Accessibility Testing for iOS Apps
description: Ensure your iOS apps are accessible to all users with automated and manual accessibility testing strategies.
content:
## Why Accessibility Matters

Over 1 billion people worldwide have some form of disability. Accessible apps reach more users and are often required by law.

## iOS Accessibility Features

- VoiceOver (screen reader)
- Dynamic Type (text sizing)
- Reduce Motion
- High Contrast
- Switch Control

## Automated Testing

```swift
func testAccessibility() throws {
    let app = XCUIApplication()
    app.launch()

    try app.performAccessibilityAudit()
}
```

## Manual Testing Checklist

- [ ] All interactive elements have labels
- [ ] Images have descriptive alt text
- [ ] Color is not the only indicator
- [ ] Touch targets are at least 44x44 points
- [ ] Content is readable with Dynamic Type
- [ ] App works with VoiceOver enabled

## Best Practices

1. Set accessibility labels and hints
2. Use semantic elements
3. Support Dynamic Type
4. Test with VoiceOver regularly
5. Use Accessibility Inspector in Xcode
author: QA Pilot Team
